controls.title: Access Control Policy
controls.summary: Access to networked services must be restricted in accordance with an established access control policy.

controls.title: Secure Log-on Procedures
controls.summary: Systems should enforce strong log-on mechanisms so that only authorized users can access protected functionality.

controls.title: Access Control for Applications
controls.summary: Public endpoints should enforce access control and authentication policies.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.summary: Security events should be logged to record actions that could affect information security.

controls.title: Cryptography (Weak Hash)
controls.summary: Cryptographic controls should avoid weak hash algorithms such as MD5.

controls.title: Cryptography (Weak Cipher)
controls.summary: Cryptographic controls should avoid weak or deprecated ciphers and insecure modes.

controls.title: Cryptography (Insecure Randomness)
controls.summary: Security-sensitive code should use cryptographically strong randomness rather than predictable PRNGs.

controls.title: Secure Development (SQL Injection)
controls.reference: Pragmatic mapping for OWASP Benchmark evaluation
controls.summary: Application code should prevent SQL injection by avoiding dynamic query construction with untrusted input.

controls.title: Secure Development (Path Traversal)
controls.reference: Pragmatic mapping for OWASP Benchmark evaluation
controls.summary: Application code should prevent path traversal by avoiding direct file path construction from untrusted input.

controls.title: Secure Development (Command Injection)
controls.reference: Pragmatic mapping for OWASP Benchmark evaluation
controls.summary: Application code should prevent command injection by avoiding shell or process command construction from untrusted input.

controls.title: Secure Development (LDAP Injection)
controls.reference: Pragmatic mapping for OWASP Benchmark evaluation
controls.summary: Application code should prevent LDAP injection by avoiding concatenated LDAP filter construction with untrusted input.

controls.title: Secure Development (XPath Injection)
controls.reference: Pragmatic mapping for OWASP Benchmark evaluation
controls.summary: Application code should prevent XPath injection by avoiding concatenated XPath expression construction with untrusted input.
